title: Editor crash on Close All Tabs
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.8b3
- `master` branch build from 4173760fdf6c2c722e82e08cb58e55f34c9efd80





### System information

### Steps to reproduce

- create Scene A, Scene B
- open Scene A, Scene B
- add Scene B as a node into Scene A
- Select "Close All Tabs" from context menu of Scene A tab while Scene A is active


(in the attached MVP consider `s1` as Scene A, `s4` as Scene B)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tabcrash.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30887751/tabcrash.tar.gz)
